initialInventory.description: Initial source inventory before migration. Property values only; 15 local LESS color definitions from the broad 1622-statement inventory are not R10 properties. R10 keys preserve selector stack, property and value; check results also provide source lines. Only the tolerated list is the shrinking migration baseline. Shared CMS module styles remain in scope because the public user data form uses them.

colorExemptions.reason: Admin backend remains static; excluded from the component color migration by user decision.
CMS administration and page editors use the admin template and remain static.
Media selection overlay belongs to CMS administration.
Campaign administration uses the admin template and remains static.
